name.description: Human label shown in UI (Claude, Grok, …).

share.description: Public URL publish (artifact), clipboard-only (copy), or hidden (none).

watch.description: Delivery mode: pushed stream events, or bounded pull waits followed by an explicit claim.

turnGate.description: Whether the Host can block a turn that tries to end with a delivered round unanswered.

browser.description: Host can navigate and run harvest scripts.

updateDetect.description: Where to look for an installed copy when deciding whether to show an update banner. none skips the check.

howLead.description: Sentence above the install command block in the update banner.

commands.description: Commands the user runs to update.
